items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Almost one fella I knew who played that band, he was called Riffith Harrison Bones.

ctx.x: you know? I thought maybe some of them were here, you could tell us where to find them, you know?
Oh, no, them fellas. Almost one fella I knew who played that band, he was called Riffith Harrison Bones. Oh, he was in that band. Yeah, he was in that band. He was playing trumpet.
Was it in the Deer Range or the Magnolia?
